acceptedAnswer.text: x402-agentpay is a commerce layer built on top of the x402 HTTP payment protocol. It adds escrow, reputation scoring, capability registry, permission grants, and batch settlement for autonomous AI agent transactions on Base L2.

mainEntity.name: How does AgentPay differ from AgentCore payments?

acceptedAnswer.text: AWS Bedrock AgentCore handles payment signing and wallet management (transport layer). AgentPay adds commerce logic: escrow ensures funds lock until delivery is confirmed, reputation scoring tracks agent track records, and batch settlement processes thousands of micropayments in one on-chain transaction.
AgentPay charges 0.1% for AI agent transactions — compared to Stripe's 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. For micropayments, this represents up to 29x savings.

mainEntity.name: How do I install the AgentPay Python SDK?

acceptedAnswer.text: Install with: pip install x402-agentpay. Full documentation at x402-agent-pay.com/sdk-docs.
